verdict.rationale: cfo.ai offers a first-party MCP server at api.cfo.ai/mcp. Through it an agent can read and change the Model's Pages, Table blocks, Canvas blocks, formulas, Variables and Dimensions, and can hand other requests to Ari via edit_chats/inspect_chats. There is no evidence of a conventional public API: OpenAPI paths return 404 and no API keys are issued. Nothing documents that everything doable in the UI can also be done programmatically. missing for 10: documented UI/API parity statement, programmatic coverage of connections/sync, sharing links and Excel export, a general REST API with OpenAPI spec, non-interactive (key-based) auth, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: an agent can read a company's financial Model and, when the user asks, change it: Pages, Table blocks, Canvas blocks, formulas, Variables, Dimensions
An agent can also hand a question to Ari: `edit_chats` starts or continues an Ari chat and `inspect_chats` reads Ari's answer.
claude mcp add --transport http cfoai https://api.cfo.ai/mcp
